LHX.sentence: L3Harris is down a touch and has badly lagged the other big defense contractors lately, but nothing about the actual business has changed — defense spending is still a steady tailwind, so it's really just fallen out of favor for now.

ASML.sentence: ASML is flat and quiet — they're still the only company on earth making the machines that print the most advanced chips, and after its big run the price has settled back into a fairly normal range for a business that grows this reliably.

LIN.sentence: Linde is having a calm week — industrial gas demand is steady and they keep nudging prices up under long-term contracts, though unusually the stock is priced no richer than a rival despite its usual quality edge.

MSFT.sentence: Microsoft is quiet — it's massively outrun the other big AI names over the past month, and the Azure cloud and AI infrastructure story keeps grinding along without any drama.

TMO.sentence: Thermo Fisher had a nice week as biotech funding starts thawing, which means more lab orders down the road — though the shares have already jumped a lot in anticipation.

ENB.sentence: Enbridge edged up, and its pipelines keep collecting toll-road-like fees while paying a hefty dividend that's now generous enough to look genuinely appealing.

NOW.sentence: ServiceNow is way off its highs even though big companies and government agencies keep signing on for its AI automation tools — it's fallen further than the business seems to justify.

GLNCY.sentence: Glencore edged up but has lagged the copper price, which is surging — so this miner and trader may have some catching up to do.

MLM.sentence: Martin Marietta dipped, but the price it gets per ton of crushed stone is still rising and it's shipping more rock, which is the part that actually matters — don't be fooled by a headline price that looks soft, that's just a shift in product mix.

KOF.sentence: Coca-Cola FEMSA is flat and uneventful — the Mexican peso is stable, which is what matters most since much of its earnings come from there.

PBR.A.sentence: Petrobras had a nice up day helped by strong oil prices, but those high oil prices mean its earnings are probably near a peak rather than a bargain.

AMKBY.sentence: Maersk, the container shipping giant, has run up fast recently and looks stretched in the short term, so this is a spot where trimming makes sense.

MA.sentence: Mastercard was flat and, oddly, is priced slightly cheaper than its twin Visa despite usually commanding a premium — people keep tapping their cards more than ever, so the business is fine.

ISRG.sentence: The surgical robot maker dropped sharply this week, but there's no sign hospitals are using its machines less — it looks like nervous selling rather than any real problem with the business.
